evidence.quote: Without him, Tommy believed an instant panic would set in; and, the honest men left to themselves, an eleventh-hour reconciliation would be possible.
that the whole organization would crumble ignominiously and instantaneously.
the Government had called an eleventh-hour conference

adjudications.reason: Partly confirmed. The revision keeps Tommy's collapse thesis ('rightly or wrongly... crumble') but drops the mechanism of his 'preposterous dream': panic, then honest men free for an eleventh-hour reconciliation. That belief is what 028's eleventh-hour conference later bears out. The flat 'public opinion would swing' line and the missing coup clause are tolerable compression. The surrounding free indirect narration ('Tommy put his doubts aside. But time pressed.') keeps it in Tommy's thinking, and earlier chapters establish the strike plot. Restoring only the reconciliation sentence keeps the cost down.

evidence.quote: "Stay here! When I begin to sing, watch that window."
It had been a favourite on the gramophone in Tuppence's hospital days.
I knew it was you last night.

adjudications.reason: The function survives. The hospital-days sentence immediately follows the song. Tommy's 'When I begin to sing, watch that window' makes the signal intent explicit, and the note's 'I knew it was you last night' confirms recognition. Dependency 2's local evidence is present verbatim.

evidence.quote: They ran him down the drive, and neatly out of the gate. Anyone would have sworn that the butler was a real butler
thereby producing a great deal more noise than if they had stood upright

adjudications.reason: This is a legitimate tradeoff at this length. The comic register of the ejection survives through 'dear old whiskers', 'neatly out of the gate', 'Anyone would have sworn' and the verbatim Whittington sting. The stomach-crawling joke also survives, so the plan's 'stay comic' requirement is met. Puma/cobra was optional.

evidence.quote: It was one Tommy would have recognized anywhere! Tuppence was in that house!
threw a silhouette on the blind. Tuppence was in that house!

adjudications.reason: Partly confirmed. 'Threw a silhouette on the blind. Tuppence was in that house!' gives the leap no basis; the source's recognition sentence supplies it cheaply. The handwriting line is not contradicted: 028 says 'It's her handwriting all right'. It is acceptable as bare narration, so the quick-wittedness sentence is not restored.

remaining_concerns: The repairs add about 31 words, leaving the draft roughly 29 over target. The only remaining large optional cut, the frog-croak exchange, conflicts with the essential item 'confesses his frog-croak message', so it was not cut.
Labour coup context is still absent locally; this relies on earlier chapters.

replacements.reason: Restore source sentence giving the mechanism of Tommy's belief, which 028 bears out.
